title.value: Are LLMs Breaking MT Metrics? Results of the WMT24 Metrics Shared Task
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: Are LLMs Breaking MT Metrics? Results of the WMT24 Metrics Shared Task

analysis.description: The paper discusses the WMT24 Metrics Shared Task which evaluated the performance of automatic metrics for machine translation (MT), especially focusing on LLM-based translations. The task aims to assess whether existing MT evaluation metrics can accurately evaluate LLM-generated translations, involving a variety of metrics and contrastive challenge sets.

type.justification: The paper is empirical as it involves the evaluation of various MT metrics through experiments and analyses, including the use of WMT24 data sets and human assessments.
type.quote: The WMT24 Metrics Shared Task evaluated the performance of automatic metrics for machine translation (MT), with a major focus on LLM-based translations.

name.justification: The paper primarily discusses the evaluation of machine translation metrics and involves human and machine translations across several language pairs.

name.quote: As LLMs become increasingly popular in MT, it is crucial to determine whether existing evaluation metrics can accurately assess the output of these systems.
